messages.content: Resuelve problemas de palabras paso a paso.
El tren A sale de la ciudad X a 60 km/h hacia el este. El tren B sale de la ciudad Y (300 km al este) a 80 km/h hacia el oeste, 30 minutos después. ¿Cuándo y dónde se encuentran?

message.content:
<think>The user asks: "El tren A sale de la ciudad X a 60 km/h hacia el este. El tren B sale de la ciudad Y (300 km al este) a 80 km/h hacia el oeste, 30 minutos después. ¿Cuándo y dónde se encuentran?" So we need to solve a relative motion problem. Let's parse the problem: There are two cities X and Y, separated by 300 km, with Y east of X. Train A departs from X heading east at 60 km/h. Train B departs from Y heading west (i.e., towards X) at 80 km/h, but leaves 30 minutes (0.5 hours) after train A. We need to find when (time after A's departure) and where (distance from X) they meet.

We can set up coordinate: x = 0 at X, x = 300 km at Y. Train A position as function of time t (hours after A departure): x_A(t) = 60 t.

Train B leaves after 0.5 h, so its time is t' = t - 0.5 (if t >= 0.5). Its position: x_B(t) = 300 - 80 * (t - 0.5). They meet when x_A = x_B. Solve: 60 t = 300 - 80 (t - 0.5). Expand: 60 t = 300 - 80 t + 40. So 60 t + 80 t = 300 + 40 => 140 t = 340 => t = 340/140 = 34/14 = 17/7 ≈ 2.428571... hours. That's about 2.428571 hours after A's departure. In minutes: 0.428571 hours = 0.428571*60 = 25.7143 minutes (approx 25.714 minutes). So about 2 hours 25 minutes 43 seconds.

Now find meeting location: x = 60 * t = 60 * (17/7) = (60*17)/7 = 1020/7 ≈ 145.714 km from X. Or using B: x = 300 - 80*(t - 0.5) = 300 - 80*(17/7 - 0.5). 0.5 = 1/2 = 3.5/7. So t - 0
